artworks.title: Révolution, Famille désespérée
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on light blue-green laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a detailed interior setting. The central figure, a man with wavy hair, gestures towards a woman and several children. The woman and children have curly hair and wear elaborate historical clothing. The background features a decorative column, ornate moldings, and a staircase with a railing. Strong lighting creates dramatic shadows on the walls and floor tiles.

artworks.title: Nick Biddle
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays a man with mature facial features, a full beard, and short textured hair. He sits or stands upright, facing slightly towards the camera. He wears a buttoned-up jacket that seems to be a uniform with shoulder straps and buttons down the front. An item hangs from his right side. The background is plain, contrasting subtly with his clothing and complexion. At the bottom of the image, text provides context about the individual named Nick Biddle.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Baby
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body and head of a young child lying on its side. The child is resting on an unseen surface, with one arm bent under the chin and the other visible along the side. The facial features include closed eyes, a small nose, and softly rounded cheeks. The child has light, curly hair that appears fluffy and rests gently around the head. The child is wrapped in a light fabric that blends into the background. The background is a plain, light color without any distinct features. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the child.

artworks.title: H.H. Worthing Photographer
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image is a collage of numerous small photographic portraits filling the frame. The individuals are posed in various positions, from standing to seated, looking at the camera or in profile. The facial features and hairstyles are varied, with some women wearing bonnets or elaborate up-dos, and men sporting mustaches or beards. Clothing ranges from formal to casual attire, indicative of different styles from an earlier era. Several individuals are holding or leaning on objects like chairs or tables. The background consists of overlapping photographs within a frame with the text "H. H. Worthing, Photographer" at the bottom. The images have a vintage sepia tone typical of photos from the late 19th to early 20th centuries.

artworks.title: Participants, Sanitary Fair, Albany, New York
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald and Kathleen Perisho
artworks.description: The image shows a group of seven individuals. Four women are seated in the front, while two men stand in the back. The women wear dresses with star motifs and headpieces. One man wears a military-style uniform, while the other wears a suit with a bow tie. Another man is seated on the left, wearing a dark suit. In the background, an American flag is displayed with an eagle emblem. The setting includes a plain wall and a patterned floor.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Photographer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a figure with a disproportionately large head standing with one hand resting on a wooden camera. The person has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a profile view with distinct facial features. They are dressed in 19th-century attire and the background is plain with the photographer's information at the bottom.

artworks.title: Millie Christine McCoy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two young women standing back-to-back against a console table. Both have curly, short to medium-length hair with flowers and ribbons. They wear matching dresses with puffed sleeves and knee-high socks with lace-up boots. The woman on the left rests her head on her hand while the other holds a bouquet. Both wear matching bracelets on their wrists. A guitar leans against the console table, and the floor is covered with a patterned carpet. The upper wall is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man holding a revolver. He has a short beard and mustache, styled dark hair, and is dressed in a military-style jacket, light trousers, and gaiters. Next to him is a cloth-covered table with a hat. The background includes a fluted column and a patterned carpet, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of Three Girls
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three children standing closely together from the waist up. The child in the middle lightly leans on the shoulder of the child to the left. The child on the right appears to be the oldest, with a small smile and medium-length, neatly combed hair. The child on the left has similar hair, parted in the middle and tucked behind their ears. The child in the middle has wavy hair and appears relaxed, resting their head on their folded arms. They are all dressed in detailed garments; the child on the right wears a patterned dress with short, puffed sleeves, while the child in the middle has a dress with dark, zigzag patterns near the collar and sleeves. The child on the left wears a similar dress to the child on the right, paired with a delicate necklace. The background is plain, with a simple frame surrounding the photograph.

artworks.title: F.A. Lee and Daughter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl and an older man in formal attire in a studio setting. The girl stands next to the seated man, with her left hand on his shoulder and her right hand holding a straw hat. She wears a ruffled dress with a striped pattern and a wide belt. The man wears a suit with a vest and holds a top hat in his right hand.

artworks.title: Learning is Wealth. Wilson, Charley, Rebecca & Rosa, Slaves from New  Orleans
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Harris in memory of Shirlee A. Harris
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals positioned together. An adult male is seated on a chair holding an open book. He has short, dark hair and is dressed in a light-colored jacket, dark shirt, and trousers. Three children are seated and standing beside him. The girls have long hair and are holding books. One girl wears a light-colored dress with dark stripes, the other girl wears a plain dress. The boy stands between them, dressed in a dark shirt and holding a book. They appear to be conversing or reading together. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Adelina Patti
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Harris in memory of Howard and Evelyne Daitz
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated. She is leaning against a small table, with her right hand on papers and her left hand holding a small object. Her gaze is towards the camera. The woman has delicate facial features and dark eyebrows and eyes. Her hair is styled in ringlets, partly covered by a floral headpiece. She wears a white or light-colored wedding dress with lace detailing, a veil, and a pearl necklace. The background includes an ornate wall with patterned wallpaper, a vintage clock, and a decorated cabinet.

artworks.title: Figures Deciphering an Inscription, with Two Women Seated [Study for Oeuvres de Bossuet, IV]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper, laid down on album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: There is a sketch of five figures, each depicted with their entire bodies shown. The figure on the far left appears to be bending forward, wearing a broad-brimmed hat. Adjacent to this figure, another person leans over with crossed arms. In the center foreground, a kneeling figure leans on their left arm. To the right, a seated figure faces away with hair in a bun, and behind them is another seated figure. The figures wear loose clothing, and pencil strokes suggest folds in the fabric. The background is plain with a slightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Jenny
artworks.creditLine: Robert Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, sitting in a relaxed position with her right arm resting on a chair. She has a composed expression on her face, with subtle facial features and wears a headscarf wrapped around her hair. She is dressed in a patterned dress with long sleeves and a high collar, adorned with lace trim at the sleeve cuffs. The dress has a repeating pattern. She wears a brooch or pendant around her neck. The background is plain.

artworks.title: U-Se-Do-Ha
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing upright with her hair styled in two braids. She gazes directly at the camera with a composed expression. She wears a long garment and a plaid blanket, paired with a necklace. The background is plain with neutral tones.

artworks.title: Thomas "Blind Tom" Wiggins
artworks.creditLine: Robert Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: In this image, a man is shown from the waist up sitting on a chair with his right arm resting on the armrest. He is positioned facing slightly towards the left with his head tilted down. The man's facial features include a rounded face, closed eyes, and full lips, with short curly hair. He is wearing a buttoned-up jacket over a light-colored shirt. The background is plain with a portion of another object visible to the left side. The chair has details of fringe or tassels visible along the armrest, and there's no additional detail in the immediate background.

artworks.title: Mercury Abducting Psyche
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two intertwined human figures. One figure holds an object on raised fingertips above their head, while the other figure embraces them closely. The bodies are detailed with visible musculature and dynamic poses. The material appears to be a monochromatic stone or metal, with shading. The sculpture is supported on a pedestal with inscriptions at the base. The figures are rendered lifelike in proportion and detail.

artworks.title: Mercury Abducting Psyche
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two human figures entwined in a dynamic pose. One figure wears a helmet with wings and ankle wings, while the other figure embraces them closely. The figures are detailed and appear to be in motion. The sculpture is metallic with a gray tone finish, and it stands on a rectangular base.

artworks.title: Children Parodying a Triumph of Bacchus
artworks.medium: red chalk with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: There is a sepia-toned drawing of a group of individuals in a natural setting. The scene features people interacting joyously, some playing musical instruments or holding festive objects. Trees frame the gathering, with a figure overlooking the scene from a raised platform. The drawing is detailed, with flowing garments and foliage creating a lively atmosphere. The precise lines and shading add depth and motion to the image, capturing a moment in what could be a narrative or celebratory event.

artworks.title: Seated Boy with Head Down
artworks.medium: gray wash on laid paper, on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person sitting down in a relaxed position. The person leans slightly to one side with one hand on the ground and the other hand near their knee. Their head is slightly bowed, with their facial features subtly depicted. They wear a large hat covering much of their face, along with a long coat, trousers, and shoes. The background is minimalistic with faint shading, providing a contrast to the person's figure. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing lines and shadows.

artworks.title: Troilus and Cressida, Act IV, Scene V: The Fight Between Hector and Ajax II
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with two figures on foot in the foreground, two riders on horses, and a blurred horizon in the background. Loose and expressive brushstrokes create motion and form. The monochromatic color palette consists of shades of gray and black. Trees are depicted on the left and right sides of the composition.

artworks.title: A Scene in an Historical Play Exhibited on the Chinese Stage
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a ceremonial scene in traditional East Asian clothing. One figure is bowing deeply on the ground, while another elaborately dressed figure stands nearby. A procession of figures carrying banners and musical instruments adds to the ceremonial atmosphere. Architectural features, decorative elements, lanterns, and columns suggest a grand hall or temple setting. A smoke-emitting vessel on the right suggests ritualistic undertones. This is a piece inspired by 18th-century Chinese art, likely portraying a scene rich in cultural symbolism and hierarchical gestures.

artworks.title: Coastal View in Normandy, with a Beached Boat
artworks.medium: watercolor with scratching out over traces of graphite(?) on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: This image shows a coastal scene with a sailboat on the sand. The horizon, sky, water, additional boat, brushstrokes, color palette, background buildings, and mood are also depicted.

artworks.title: Four Actresses in Theatrical Costume
artworks.medium: red and gray wash with pen and black ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows four women standing side by side. Each woman is in a forward-facing stance with some turned slightly to the side. They have delicate facial features and distinct expressions, adorned with elaborate hairstyles featuring bows and flowers. The women wear layered, detailed dresses with ruffles, bows, lace, and fitted bodices. The first woman on the left holds a folded fan, and the last woman on the right wears a necklace. The background is plain.
